summary: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of the sale of select European olefins and polyolefins assets and associated business to AEQUITA. The transaction was governed by a Sale and Purchase Agreement dated October 29, 2025. No price per share, premium, or implied value is disclosed. The filing incorporates the SPA by reference and notes customary post-closing covenants. As a completed sale, the structural risk is minimal; watch for any earnout or post-closing adjustments tied to the covenants mentioned.
